@[rust_loop_body]
def owned_checkpoint_nonzero_loop.body
  (bytes : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow Std.Usize (Option Bool))
  := do
  let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len bytes
  if i < i1
  then
    let i2 ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes
        i
    if i2 != 0#u8
    then ok (done (some true))
    else let i3 ← i + 1#usize
         ok (cont i3)
  else ok (done none)

/-- [aspis_s126_owned_stage1::owned_checkpoint_nonzero]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 62:0-69:1

def owned_checkpoint_nonzero (bytes : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  let pending_return ← owned_checkpoint_nonzero_loop bytes 0#usize
  match pending_return with
  | none => ok false
  | some b => ok b
